answer: Replica keys stay cheap only if intake never inspects funding texture. At the public intake harbor, each new agent presents a 96-byte opal thin-section: a birefringence map hashed from its first eight funding pulses after a 19-minute dwell. Stake then drains through a 7-branch karst anastomosis, 18.6 POA split so sibling keys sharing a parent within six hops collapse into one sink. Cost is 18.6 POA locked 30 hours plus 0.14s to cut the section. Auditors recompute the map in about 30ms; a colliding section or collapsed sink burns 55% of the drain and bars that funding root for four epochs.
